runtime.title: Native agent runtime
runtime.hint: Cap how many model-and-tool rounds run for one user message. 0 means unlimited. Local and SSH workspaces share these caps because the loop always runs on this machine. Applies to sessions started after you change them.
runtime.maxSubagentTurnsHint: 0 = unlimited, default 20, max 500. Independent from the parent agent turn cap. Shared by local and SSH workspaces. Applies to sessions started after you change it.
runtime.contextWindowHint: Enter K tokens (1K = 1,000 tokens). When the switch below is on, older history is compacted before this window fills. When off (default), the current AI channel model's maximum context is used. Custom range 8K–1,000K.
runtime.rolloutBudgetHint: Enter K tokens (1K = 1,000 tokens). Shared by the parent and child agents. New tool turns stop when it is reached. 0 = unlimited; default 10,000K; max 100,000K.
runtime.maxToolOutputHint: Enter K tokens (1K = 1,000 tokens). Large results keep their head and tail and include a path/offset continuation hint. Default 4.096K; range 0.256K–65.536K.
runtime.maxConcurrentHint: How many child agents may run in parallel in one model turn. Default 1, range 1–16. Shared by local and SSH workspaces. Applies to sessions started after you change it.
runtime.policyHint: How eagerly the parent delegates. Types come from the Agent tool: built-in explore / general plus custom types from the Sub-agents page. Applies to sessions started after you change it.
runtime.budgetShareHint: Each batch of sub-agents may use at most this percent of the parent session's remaining budget in total. Default 40, range 5–100. The parent can continue after the batch hits its cap.
runtime.permissionModeHint: Confirm before change: ask before editing files. Automatic editing: overwrite files immediately; delete / push / force Git / opaque commands / MCP still prompt. Full access: fewer confirmations. Plan mode is chosen in the Composer and is not stored here. Applies to sessions started after you change it.
runtime.permissionTimeoutHint: How long to wait for confirmation. Timeout is treated as deny and the session continues. 0 = no timeout, default 300.
runtime.checkpointsHint: Optionally save a Git checkpoint after successful file-writing tools. Expired post-tool checkpoints from ended sessions are pruned when a repository opens.
runtime.autoCheckpoint: Create a checkpoint after file changes
runtime.checkpointRetention: Post-tool checkpoint retention days (0 = never prune)
runtime.globalPromptHint: Inserted as the Global prompt block after environment context and before AGENTS.md / profile settings. Leave empty to skip. Applies to sessions started after you change it.

includesItems: Full SQLite data (workspaces, SSH configs, AI channels and API keys, sessions and events, Git checkpoint metadata, API call logs, and more)
excludesItems: SSH passwords / private-key passphrases in the keyring (service noxcode-ssh)
ssh-secret-index.json in the app config directory
mcp-servers.json, native-settings.json (including hooks), network-settings.json, and quick-prompts.json in the app config directory
Local UI state such as window size
